event.title: Tampa Bay Rays Reach World Series After Defeating Cleveland Guardians
event.canonical_title: Tampa Bay Rays Reach World Series After Defeating Cleveland Guardians
event.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays have advanced to the 2026 World Series after defeating the Cleveland Guardians 7-3 in Game 6 of the American League Championship Series. Junior Caminero and Yandy Diaz each contributed two-run homers, while Freddy Peralta pitched 5 1/3 innings to secure the victory. This marks the Rays' third appearance in the World Series in the franchise's 29-year history, where they will face the Milwaukee Brewers.
